vocab.sentence: That story teaches a moral lesson about honesty.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那個故事讓人學到誠實的重要性。

vocab.sentence: When I lie, it bothers my conscience.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 每次說謊，我都會良心不安。

vocab.sentence: She sacrificed her afternoon to help her brother study.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她犧牲了自己的下午時間，幫弟弟讀書。

vocab.sentence: Sheila was exhausted after a long day at work.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 工作了一整天後，Sheila 筋疲力竭。

vocab.sentence: They assisted their coworkers with the project.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他們協助同事進行這個專案。

vocab.sentence: It can be tough to make friends in a big city.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 在大城市交朋友可能很困難。

vocab.sentence: Her schedule is flexible, so she can meet anytime.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她的行程有彈性，所以隨時都可以見面。

vocab.sentence: He feels guilty about saying no to his mom.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他因為拒絕了媽媽而感到內疚。

vocab.sentence: Trying to ease his guilt, he said he was sorry several times.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 為了減輕內疚感，他道歉了好幾次。

vocab.sentence: She smiled guiltily after taking the last cookie.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她拿走最後一塊餅乾後，內疚地笑了笑。

vocab.sentence: Do not bully other students at school.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 在學校不要欺負其他學生。

vocab.sentence: She showed integrity when she told the truth.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她說出實話，展現了正直。

vocab.sentence: He tried to cram all his clothes into one bag.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他試著把所有衣服都塞進同一個袋子裡。

vocab.sentence: He had a breakdown after weeks of stress.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 承受了幾個星期的壓力後，他崩潰了。
